title: Evaluated differential module, its torsion and differential defect
statement: Let $R,B,A$ be commutative rings, let $B,A$ be $R$-algebras, and let $\varphi:B\to A$ be an $R$-algebra map. Define $M_B(\varphi)=A\otimes_{B,\varphi}\Omega_{B/R}$ using [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] and [def-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials]. Define $T_B(\varphi)\subset M_B(\varphi)$ as the submodule of elements annihilated by a non-zero-divisor of $A$; when $A$ is a domain, this means annihilated by some nonzero $a\in A$. Set $\delta_B(\varphi)=\operatorname{length}_A T_B(\varphi)\in\mathbf N\cup\{\infty\}$ [def-weil-pbc-module-length].
